messages:
dana (Billing): Quick heads-up 38 10SableTech INV-2026-1520 is 28 days overdue for USD 5,900. Card token shows 'card_declined_processing_error' and ACH returned R01. Customer says they're reconciling vendor codes after a finance system migration and asked for a 14-day accommodation while they complete it. They also asked to avoid a collections notation on their account.
harry (Collections): For mid-market customers we can offer a short accommodation if there's a clear plan. Two options: 1) accept 25% today and staged payments 35/40 at 30/60; or 2) pause dunning for 14 days with a signed acknowledgement and require payment method update. Any concession >$250 needs FinOps approval.
meera (FinOps): Finance can approve fee concession up to $250. Anything that materially modifies payment terms (beyond 30 days) requires Revenue Ops + Finance alignment. We should log any concession in AR with GL 4320-CONCESSION. If they insist on no collections flag we won't change external reporting; we can only hold internal suspension.
dice (note): (internal)
dana (Billing): Customer offered to push 40% via wire if we accept a conditional hold and remove the immediate suspension. They promised PO and bank confirmation within 24h.
vince (AE): I'm on the thread; customer says treasury is stretched but will wire 40% today if we can accept a 3-pay schedule (40/30/30) and stop escalation. They will also sign a payment plan.
harry (Collections): I prefer the wire + signed plan. Draft payment plan should include: auto-retry for failed debits, clause to reinstate dunning if milestone missed, and an audit trail + signature. I'll draft and ping Legal.
legal (Legal): I'll review the plan. Standard clause: accommodation is conditional on clearing of the initial payment and receipt of PO. Also include a 7-day cure window before service actions.
audits-bot: System: invoice INV-2026-1520 status set to "accommodation_requested" by dana (Billing) at 2345678920.
meera (FinOps): Approve conditional concession: waive late fees up to $200 contingent on receiving the 40% wire and a signed payment plan. Finance will tag GL 4320 and include note for the weekly AR summary. If wire doesn't clear within 48h, we reverse the concession and resume normal collections.
dana (Billing): I'll send the payment plan link and wire instructions now. Harry 1 please own the doc and follow-ups.
harry (Collections): Will do. Draft ready in 15m and will circulate for legal quick review. Setting follow-up reminders for 48h.
vince (AE): Customer replied: treasury initiated wire; they'll email proof + PO within 6 hours and sign the plan. Thanks team.
meera (FinOps): Once the wire posts Finance will record receipt and reconcile. Please ensure the concession is captured in the invoice notes.
dana (Billing): Noted. I'll update the invoice with audit entries and close the loop once funds post. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
